snapshot_or_version: v1.1 card update (Spring 2026); Fall 2024-Spring 2025 course data; 2,214 conversations from 203 consenting students
interaction_origin: Operational human-LLM use in a deployed university course assistant; students opted in and used it while working on assignments
continuity: Full multi-turn history with chatId, timestamps, anonymized userId, assignment topic, semester, and optional grade/submission linkage; supports within-chat and cross-chat continuity
access: Gated Hugging Face repository; account, contact-information sharing, and acceptance of access conditions required
license_or_terms: Published dataset license: CC BY 4.0; card states research or educational use and requires attribution
privacy_risk: HIGH: educational records, assignment content, grades, timestamps, and stable pseudonymous student linkage can enable re-identification despite regex PII filtering
intended_use: Highest-priority governed pilot; label corrections, preferences, and state changes only after removing grade/submission fields and assignment-identifying artifacts; link upstream and do not redistribute transcripts by default

snapshot_or_version: 2018-07-01 Wikipedia dumps; English, Chinese, German, Greek, and Russian editions
interaction_origin: Operational human-human Wikipedia Talk activity reconstructed from revision history; not human-LLM chat
continuity: Strong public lineage through conversation, page, user, revision, parent, ancestor, reply, and timestamp identifiers; includes creation, addition, modification, deletion, and restoration actions
access: Open download through Google Cloud, Figshare, and ConvoKit
license_or_terms: Published terms: compilation under CC0 1.0; individual comment content under CC BY-SA 3.0 with Wikipedia attribution and share-alike requirements
privacy_risk: HIGH: usernames, timestamps, toxic content, user-talk pages, and deleted or restored comments remain linkable to public revision history
intended_use: Use as an explicit edit, correction, deletion, restoration, and rollback lineage source, not as primary human-AI evidence; retain source revision and attribution metadata and review deleted content before use

snapshot_or_version: Hugging Face main and arXiv:2605.20087v2, May 2026; 1,058 users, 2,155 conversations, 17,058 turns
interaction_origin: Elicited naturalistic human-LLM study conversations on open-ended everyday tasks, collected from recruited participants through a study chatbot; not passive production logs
continuity: Timestamped full multi-turn conversations, median 8 turns, pseudonymous user IDs across multiple tasks/conversations, message-linked reasons and reactions, and post-task summaries
license_or_terms: Published dataset license: CC BY 4.0; paper safeguards describe research use, informed consent, no re-identification, and no manipulative or surveillance use of inferred mental states
privacy_risk: HIGH: latent thoughts, reactions, timestamps, repeated-user linkage, and demographic/usage metadata are sensitive even after direct identifiers are removed
intended_use: High-value elicited pilot for corrections, dissatisfaction, expectations, and preference changes; remove demographic linkage from annotation packets and exclude mental-state exploitation or surveillance use

snapshot_or_version: Living dataset observed 2026-08-03: 205 repositories, 5,851 sessions, and 2,692,480 interaction rows
interaction_origin: Operational developer-agent sessions checkpointed by Entire CLI users in public GitHub repositories
continuity: Strong session, turn, checkpoint, repository, commit, continuation, timestamp, tool-call, and code-attribution lineage; can connect prompts to resulting code and commits
access: Gated Hugging Face repository; account, contact-information sharing, and acceptance of access conditions required
license_or_terms: Published dataset license: ODC-BY; embedded source code, file content, command output, repository licenses, and agent-provider terms remain source-specific
privacy_risk: HIGH: prompts, paths, commands, code, commit author names/emails, GitHub identities, and secrets can survive automated Presidio and TruffleHog filtering
intended_use: Label correction, rejection, failure-report, and requirement-change events against code outcomes; pin a dated snapshot and perform repo-level license/privacy review; do not release raw traces by default

snapshot_or_version: 2024 release, DOI 10.57967/hf/2113; 1,500 participants and 8,011 conversation trees
interaction_origin: Elicited real-time study conversations by recruited participants using a dedicated interface with model choice, ratings, and fine-grained feedback
continuity: Two to 22 turns per tree; user_id links roughly six conversations, ratings, open-ended feedback, and a detailed participant survey within the study
license_or_terms: Published terms: human-written text under CC BY 4.0; model responses under CC BY-NC 4.0 and original provider terms; research/education purpose and no-deanonymization condition
privacy_risk: HIGH: detailed demographics and stated preferences are linked to controversial/value-laden conversations and repeated-user behavior
intended_use: Annotate within-study preference, correction, and feedback transitions after separating human and model-output license layers and removing survey/profile linkage from annotation packets

snapshot_or_version: WildChat-4.8M non-toxic release updated 2025-08-11; coverage before 2025-08-01; 3,199,860 conversations; Full variant excluded
interaction_origin: Operational traffic from public Hugging Face chatbots backed by ChatGPT models
continuity: Full multi-turn conversations and turn IDs; hashed IP plus browser header can link conversations but must not be treated as a safe user identity
access: Non-toxic version is open on Hugging Face; Full toxic version is gated and requires justification/manual approval
license_or_terms: Published dataset license: ODC-BY; Full and non-toxic variants have separate access controls; do not assume the dataset license resolves all rights in model output or embedded third-party text
privacy_risk: HIGH: full transcripts, timestamps, hashed IP, state/country, and raw browser headers create substantial linkage risk; PII and secret filtering is best-effort
intended_use: Use only the non-toxic variant for a tightly controlled feasibility sample; drop IP, header, geography, and precise time fields before selection; keep transcripts out of the public release and exclude the Full variant

snapshot_or_version: Fixed April-June 2023 release; 33,000 cleaned pairwise conversations from 13,383 anonymized users
interaction_origin: Operational crowd use of Chatbot Arena pairwise model battles; consent obtained through collection-site terms
continuity: Full paired conversations, vote, timestamp, question ID, and anonymized user ID are present, but mean length is 1.2 turns and longitudinal continuity is weak
access: Gated Hugging Face repository; account, contact-information sharing, and acceptance of disclaimers/terms required
license_or_terms: Published terms: user prompts under CC BY 4.0; model outputs under CC BY-NC 4.0; model-specific terms and no re-identification condition also apply
privacy_risk: HIGH: full unsafe conversations, timestamps, and anonymized IP-derived user IDs remain linkable; PII removal is described as best-effort
intended_use: Use only for within-conversation preference, correction, or rejection labels; make no cross-session memory claim and keep human prompts distinct from model-output licensing

snapshot_or_version: Fixed April-August 2023 release; 1,000,000 conversations, 25 models, and 210,479 source IP addresses
interaction_origin: Operational traffic from the Vicuna demo and Chatbot Arena; consent obtained through collection-site terms
continuity: Conversation IDs and full dialogues are present with a mean of 2.0 turns; the public release does not provide a safe stable cross-conversation user identity
access: Gated Hugging Face repository; explicit acceptance of the LMSYS-Chat-1M Dataset License Agreement required
license_or_terms: Custom agreement grants a limited non-exclusive, non-transferable, non-sublicensable license; prohibits third-party transfer and permits deletion/termination demands; model-specific terms and no-identification rule apply
privacy_risk: HIGH: data originated from IP-linked traffic, contains unsafe conversations, and uses imperfect name redaction; raw access may be separately requested
intended_use: Do not use as a source for a redistributable MGP-Natural corpus; at most perform isolated feasibility analysis under the accepted agreement with no transfer of data or excerpts

snapshot_or_version: OASST1 snapshot 2023-04-12; OASST2 final snapshot 2023-11-05 with 208,584 messages and 70,642 trees
interaction_origin: Crowdsourced data-collection tasks in which volunteers author and rank alternating prompter/assistant messages; some messages are synthetic; not organic user-assistant deployment
continuity: Message-tree, parent, message, contributor, timestamp, rank, and review IDs preserve branch structure, but branches can involve multiple volunteers and do not represent one longitudinal user-assistant relationship
access: Open Hugging Face downloads; OASST2 is the final project release
license_or_terms: Published Hugging Face license and repository LICENSE: Apache-2.0 for OASST1 and OASST2
privacy_risk: MEDIUM: contributor IDs, timestamps, unsafe text, and PII flags are present; the larger scientific mismatch is elicited role-play and mixed authorship rather than operational continuity
intended_use: Use only for ontology rehearsal, annotation-tool testing, or model development; do not count it as real deployed chat or as natural longitudinal MGP evidence

snapshot_or_version: Quarterly public dump and weekly SEDE; pin network site and release date before use, for example the March 2026 dump
interaction_origin: Operational public human-human Q&A, comments, edits, rollbacks, deletion states, and moderation events; not human-LLM chat
continuity: Strong post/revision lineage through PostId, RevisionGUID, history type, user, timestamp, comment, and raw Markdown; useful for explicit state transitions
access: Public XML data dumps and read-only Stack Exchange Data Explorer
license_or_terms: Published contribution licenses vary by revision date: CC BY-SA 2.5 before 2011-04-08, CC BY-SA 3.0 until 2018-05-02, and CC BY-SA 4.0 thereafter; attribution and share-alike apply per revision
privacy_risk: HIGH: public user IDs/display names, timestamps, edit comments, location/profile fields, and historical or deleted content can identify contributors
intended_use: Use for explicit edit, correction, rollback, deletion, restoration, and current-state lineage, not personal human-AI memory; pin each revision's license and attribution and review deleted content

snapshot_or_version: No canonical or stable release; example 2023 V3 mirror files at anon8231489123/ShareGPT_Vicuna_unfiltered; mirrors diverge
interaction_origin: User-shared ChatGPT conversations collected through ShareGPT and copied, cleaned, or re-hosted by third parties; provenance and consent chains differ by mirror
continuity: Within-conversation order is often retained, but creator identity, timestamp, source URL, deletion state, and cross-session linkage are generally absent or unreliable
access: Third-party mirrors may be openly downloadable; the original collector/API is not a stable authoritative acquisition path
license_or_terms: Some mirrors label the repository Apache-2.0, but this does not document rights or terms for every original user contribution and model output; FastChat states it will not release its ShareGPT training data
privacy_risk: HIGH: public-link scraping, weak provenance, uncertain withdrawal propagation, and possible personal data or secrets; mirror cleaning is inconsistent
intended_use: Exclude mirrors from MGP-Natural acquisition and release; use only as a discovery pointer for provenance research, never as unlabeled raw source material

snapshot_or_version: Living dataset observed 2026-08-03: 30 donated sessions and 127 MB
interaction_origin: Voluntarily donated operational coding-agent sessions from public open-source repositories; local scrub, contributor confirmation, pull request, and maintainer review precede inclusion
continuity: Raw agent-native session files preserve prompts, responses, tools, command output, harness, session ID, and metadata; project continuity is available but cross-session person linkage is not a guaranteed field
license_or_terms: Published terms: compilation, structure, and metadata under CC BY 4.0; embedded code/content retains original licenses; donor certification and agent-provider terms are not independently verified
privacy_risk: HIGH: the card explicitly says anonymization is best-effort and not certified anonymous; names, identifiers, paths, internal URLs, company references, and novel secrets may remain
intended_use: Use as a small, pinned pilot for coding-agent corrections and tool-state events; strip identities and code from annotation packets and release only cleared labels/aggregates unless each trace is separately reviewed

snapshot_or_version: Repository master, one-commit release; 3,581 Korean sessions across 2-5-session episodes plus automatic English translation
interaction_origin: Crowdworkers converse with a trained bot in constructed multi-session episodes; model-generated dialogues/summaries are human revised and the 1-2 week intervals are assumed rather than observed
continuity: Explicit episode/session IDs, memory, and summary fields provide strong designed continuity, but it is elicited and partly generated rather than natural operational history
access: Original Korean data requires a form; automatic English translation is in the public repository and contains acknowledged translation noise
license_or_terms: Custom published terms restrict use to non-commercial AI research and development, prohibit modification/editing/reproduction, prohibit copying/distribution to third parties or the public, and require NAVER attribution
privacy_risk: MEDIUM: health-like senior-persona content and controlled original access warrant care, although the primary blocker is constructed provenance and restrictive published terms
intended_use: Related-work and schema-comparison reference only; do not relabel, modify, reproduce, or redistribute it as an MGP-Natural source under the published terms
